selected_evidence.summary: All existing kernel entries and `/etc/default/grub` contain `audit=1`.
After reboot, `/proc/cmdline` contains `audit=1` exactly once and `auditctl -s` reports `enabled 1`.

Healthy baseline boot ID `a6ae913f-…` was captured; the delayed reboot was acknowledged before shutdown; temporary unavailability was observed; node1 returned with boot ID `400c32dd-…`, system state `running`, zero failed units, a read-write root filesystem, and persistent `audit=1` configuration.
